reviews.review: Holy **** **** YES! Buy it! No RAGRETS!

Big risk of rain fan, but until the teleporters are easier to see / identify / find, i can't recommend this sequel. Its just not fun, running around an empty level, you've looted everything, have insane damage, etc. clock is running down and you're just spending so many minutes of your life running around doing nothing. Needs dev attention.
Worth it even if its off sale. This game is a legit blast and brain blast. Anything past stage 16 tho is just eye goop.

just play it, its absolute mayhem and I adore it, any game that can have me in a state where i'm willing to sit and play the same round for 2 and a quarter hours is well worth playing (just finished that game right before leaving this review, engineer 9 bustling fungi only lost cos the overloading worm instakills my turrets) the difficulty slowly ramping up from easy to HAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHA (not even kidding) is amazing and at late stages you'll find yourself suddenly realise whats happening and be like "how did i get here?"

two thing though you should steer clear if you don't like RNG based games, because thats all this is, items, chests, enemies, bosses, teleporter position even the secret buttons on one of the maps are all placed and decided totally at random. and if your pc isn't great the game WILL become too much, my pc is high end and in my last game even it was starting to drop to low frams due to chain reactions of enemies exploding on death then killing more enemies who also exploded, the graphics are fairly simplistic but the sheer number of enemies and particle effects can overwhelm your computer (not to mention give you a seisure from the explosions) 

all in all the game goes from basic mob looter shooter to utter chaos where you end up screaming WHAT IS GOING ON SOMEBODY HELP ME (and it does have co-op so somebody can come and help you) so if you like non-stop insane action in a game with no end (if you get far enough the game literally offers to obliterate you from existence) then this is definitely for you, just be careful about WHEN you start a game, theres no save function and you never know how long a game will take you so don't ever think "i'll just do a quick round of Risk of Rain before work" you won't, you'll miss your shift and probably the next days too cos you never want to stop a good run.
